question: Does the externally distinct five-session circulating-size leadership-transition coordinate have a replicating nonoverlapping future state dynamic?
research_role: outcome-blind temporal process after representation and external compression

availability.response_available_at: completed t+h exchange-session close at 15:00 Asia/Shanghai
availability.entry_predictor_use: forbidden; this experiment creates no action

responses.primary: the same primary transition coordinate shifted exactly five sessions earlier within view/denominator; T5(t+5)=L20(t+5)-L20(t)

neighbors.3: the raw three-session transition shifted exactly three sessions earlier within view/denominator
neighbors.10: the raw ten-session transition shifted exactly ten sessions earlier within view/denominator

responses.same_block_rule: predictor and response dates must both fall inside the temporal block
responses.nonoverlap_identity: for every horizon h in 3,5,10, Th(t)=L20(t)-L20(t-h) and Th(t+h)=L20(t+h)-L20(t) share no daily size-return component

temporal_blocks.evidence_label: both blocks reuse pre-2024 time and are exploratory, not untouched confirmation

estimation.time_series_coordinates: partial Spearman by rank-residualizing predictor and response on exactly three fixed current-date controls with intercept within each view/denominator/block
estimation.relative_rank_coordinate: within each denominator/block, pool four-view ranks, remove date fixed effects from predictor, response, and controls, then correlate predictor/response residuals after both are regressed on the three demeaned controls
estimation.relative_rank_groups: two denominators across matched four-view dates
estimation.phase_zero: every fifth valid primary predictor row within original view/denominator and block
estimation.sign: learned from block-A primary raw median and required in every other gate
estimation.raw_unadjusted: diagnostic only and cannot rescue the fixed partial estimator

gates.no_rescue: No sign, horizon, block, coordinate, phase, view, denominator, control deletion, failed role, or favorable subset can replace a failed primary or neighboring-definition gate.

prohibited_fields: future market, industry, stock, or strategy return
future size-bucket security selection or named-stock outcome
strategy membership, signal, admission, trade, P&L, MFE, MAE, exit, duration, or outcome class
size structure, one-day leadership, twenty-day leadership level, or any failed/redundant size role as predictor or control
claim_boundary: Passing establishes only a replicating outcome-blind circulating-size leadership-transition state dynamic; it does not establish a small-cap premium, market return prediction, stock selection, risk appetite, habitat fitness, timing, execution, capacity, causality, or a strategy rule.
